# Research Director
1. The Research Director is to keep a copy of all logged anomalies in their storage.
2. The Research Director is to assign Research Assistants to a departmental task. If they are inexperienced and requiring job training, the Research Director should step in or ensure someone is assigned to the Research Assistant.
3. The Research Director is not to change the laws of the AI on board, unless the Captain also consents to the law board being recommended.
4. It is the responsibility of the Research Director to use the Research and Development Console to prioritize research.
5. The Research Director is to collect the AI using the Intellicard during evacuation.
